title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AUTO - TrafficLightController
description: A device that automatically operates coloured lights, typically red, amber and green, for controlling traffic at road junctions, pedestrian crossings and roundabouts (s4auto:TrafficLightController, subclass of s4auto:RoadSideActuator).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'TrafficLightController'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. WGS84 position, modeling s4auto:Position / s4auto:GeoPosition.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

controls.description: Relationship. The AutomotiveEntity object(s)/lane(s)/approach(es) controlled by this traffic light (saref:controls).

currentSignalState.description: Property. Current colour combination shown by the traffic light. NOTE: SAREF4AUTO does not define named individuals enumerating this vocabulary explicitly; the values listed here are the illustrative/common set used in practice for this device class, not drawn verbatim from the ontology.
